messages:
maya: Quick triage — ticket volume up ~30% in the last hour. Main clusters: webhook 502s and embeddings errors. Can folks post status/blocks? cc @ops-bot for recent deploys. P0: #SUP-4298 (webhook loop), P1: #SUP-4312 (embedding errors). Need a short macro for embedding rollback steps.

jamal: Taking #SUP-4298, reproing now. Seeing 502s from gateway after ~03:20 UTC. Suspect upstream timeouts on nginx.

sophia: On #SUP-4312 — embedding failures look like a quantization mismatch after yesterday's model rollout. Holding customer traffic and opening a rollback PR (https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/789).

ops-bot: ops-bot: deploy finished for embed-service @ 2026-03-17T03:33Z — canary 20% -> 100% (no errors observed in last 5m).

liam: Pushed a draft macro tweak for embedding fallback. @maya can you review? Snippet: ```/macro edit embeddings_fallback "If embeddings fail, collect model_version, request_id, and escalate to eng-ml. Temp workaround: toggle model v2.1.2"```

ana: Sorry typo: should be ana. Ana: Approving macro tweak. Volume spike looks like two customers sending large multi-batch embed requests.

jamal: Repro steps for #SUP-4298: `curl -v https://hooks.redwood.ai/endpoint` returns intermittent 502 with upstream reset. Log snippet: ```nginx: [error] connect() failed (111: Connection refused) while connecting to upstream```

sophia: Rollback PR merged, restarting embed-service now. Monitoring metrics.

maya: Quick asks: 1) someone add a troubleshooting macro for nginx upstream-reset 502s, 2) ping for CR review on support macros PR (#832), 3) if rollback holds for 10m mark P1 as mitigated.

liam: I'll add the nginx macro now and post the PR link.

ops-bot: ops-bot: alert update — #SUP-4312 severity downgraded to P2 at 3350123460

ana: again, typo — ana: Night triage update: queue = 18 open, 4 blocking. I can take PS handoff in ~20m.

jamal: Assigned #SUP-4298 to myself, will update with full log link and a timeline.

sophia: embed-service back on v2.1.2, errors are dropping. Continuing watch for 15m.

maya: Solid. I'll draft a short KB and macro edits for both embedding rollback and webhook 502 troubleshooting, then post here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
